description: Fires strongly when the opponent has three stones stacked vertically at the top of column 0 (leftmost) with the cell above empty: a vertical must-block in column 0. Weaker if I also have an immediate win; my own vertical three in column 0 fires weakly. Horizontal or diagonal threats at column 0, and vertical threes in other columns, do not fire. Many weak near-threshold firings have no clear pattern.
effect: Zero-ablation has no measurable effect (the block in column 0 is still chosen). Forcing it to max sometimes pushes the move to column 0 (+82 points in one position) and takes probability off the centre, but in other positions nothing changes.
notes: v1 their col-0 vertical three: F1 0.442 (P 0.99, R 0.285). v2 their top-two stacked: F1 0.214, rejected. v3 adds my own col-0 three plus level grading: F1 0.452 (P 0.975, R 0.294), sim share 0.84. Precision is near perfect, but recall is capped by many weak near-threshold firings (0.56-2) that I could not explain (spread over ply and last column). Minimal pairs: column 0 only (cols 2 and 6 do not fire), vertical only, last move need not be column 0. Best synthesis 30.9 vs dev max 33.2.
